analysis: Trial succeeded operationally but did not improve validation: host macro HR@10 was 0.5613 versus the reported prior 0.565 (−0.0037), while remaining above the reported baseline 0.505. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.645; Industrial_and_Scientific 0.605; Electronics 0.430; CDs_and_Vinyl 0.565. Electronics declined from the reported prior 0.450. These results do not support the relative-position bias hypothesis for this configuration; they do not establish why performance declined. Allocated GPU time was 292.42 seconds. No test metrics were available.
code_summary: One independently trained MaskedSASRec checkpoint per category. The bidirectional, pre-normalized Transformer retains absolute positions, a final query-mask token, tied item embeddings, and jointly learned item biases. Each encoder layer adds a zero-initialized [127, num_heads] bias table indexed by clipped signed query-minus-key distance. Explicit layer execution applies these biases with padding-key exclusion. Training retains masked-prefix sampling, 1,024-negative sampled softmax, and the existing hyperparameters and validation checkpoint selection. The predictor reconstructs the architecture, strictly loads one checkpoint per category, and preserves all four routes. Included RNG-preserving checks cover zero-bias equivalence, distance indexing, padding exclusion, bidirectionality, finite scores, bias gradients, and checkpoint reload parity. No ensemble or independently fitted auxiliary scorer is used.
